lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Relative arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized in vertical columns and horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with high-luminance blobs to create a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the superior flank, each characterized by a bright upper edge and shadowed lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of discrete high-luminance blobs observed within the visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated high-luminance feature positioned ventrally relative to the pectoral fin.
